# Core Capability

Core Capability explains the supported product capability and is suitable when the current task needs the product's core behavior rather than a general overview. It relates to the Alpha Product overview and should be read after that page.

The capability supports the documented core workflow. Its boundary is that it does not cover undocumented integrations or capabilities outside the Core module. Use the product overview to choose the module, then use this page to check whether the capability fits the task.

To start using this capability, open the Alpha Product overview, choose the Core module, and then follow the documented core workflow on this page. The Core capability is related to the Alpha Product overview and is the only capability page in this sample; it does not claim a relationship to an undocumented capability.

Version and effective scope: this capability is part of Alpha Product version 1 and applies to the documented Core module workflow in the current sample.

中文说明：这个能力页只说明当前 Core 模块的已记录边界，不扩展到未记录的集成能力。
